foundation.source: stardust/prototypes/canon.css sections 1-7 (tokens, fonts, base + type, grid, buttons, header, footer)
foundation.remRoot: html { font-size: 62.5% } — 1rem = 10px, every canon rem value is unchanged

fonts.body: Inter (SIL OFL 1.1), fonts/inter.woff2, @font-face in styles/fonts.css (source's own 90%/22% overrides); first-paint stand-in inter-fallback (local Arial / Liberation Sans, size-adjust 105.56%) in styles/styles.css
fonts.display: "GT Planar VF" first (licensed, never hosted) then Liberation Sans / Arimo / Helvetica / Arial — the metric substitute renders for every visitor without a licensed copy

foundation.imgReset: img { max-width: 100%; height: auto } — inline like the source (no display:block); height:auto guards the EDS width/height attributes
foundation.sections: main > .section and main > .section > div carry no margin/padding/max-width: every block owns its grid (.wrap = 0 var(--pad-x) side padding, .col-10 = 10 of 12 columns) and its module caps (DESIGN.json extensions.breakpoints: module caps only, shellMaxWidth null); .default-content-wrapper is inset by --pad-x and capped at --max-width (1040px)
foundation.chrome: overlay: --nav-height 0, the header block root (div.header.block) is position: fixed over the first section; the footer needs no reservation
foundation.buttonMapping: a.button.primary (strong) = .btn.btn-fill paint; a.button.secondary (em) = .btn outline; a.button.accent (strong+em) = .btn-link underline; size modifiers .btn-md / .btn-sm stay block-applied
foundation.classNaming: stylelint selector-class-pattern is kebab-case: prototype BEM classes are renamed a__b--c -> a-b-c (e.g. btn--fill -> btn-fill, header__logo -> header-logo); a BEM name ending in -container/-wrapper must not keep that suffix (EDS section classes) — header__container -> header-bar, footer__container -> footer-inner, *__nav-container -> *-nav-inner, *-wrapper -> *-list / *-mobile
foundation.cursor: site-wide custom cursor (live div.circle) mounted by the header block as div.cursor-circle: follows the pointer >= 768px on fine hover pointers, .cursor-blur over a/button, .cursor-hide over iframe/video; rests off-screen at translate(0, 0)
foundation.editMode: styles.css ships the Experience Workspace snippets (a) CTA repaint from strong/em, (b) card-as-link inner anchor

chromeDocuments.nav: /nav (en) and /nav-de (German root page — needs page metadata `nav: /nav-de`)
chromeDocuments.footer: /footer (en) and /footer-de (German root page — needs page metadata `footer: /footer-de`)
chromeDocuments.robots: every chrome document carries a metadata row Robots | noindex
chromeDocuments.navModel: section 1 brand link with :diva-e-logo: icon; section 2 one nested <ul> (cards panel when its items carry images, else columns panel); section 3 :search: link, <ul> of language links, CTA as <strong> link

breakpoints: source steps 475 / 550 / 768 / 950 / 1024 / 1200 / 1280 / 1366 / 1440 / 1600; header switches burger -> pill at 1280; DESIGN.json extensions.breakpoints.target is unset, so lint:breakpoints skips
